title: phy/ecp5rgmii: Incorrect parameters in DELAYF blocks
body:
In some recent debugging I've discovered that nextpnr does not consider strings such as `"DELAY80"` a valid parameter value for `DEL_VALUE` 

See in this snippet, taken from the ecp5rgmii phy

```python
rx_delay_taps = 80

self.specials += [
       Instance("DELAYF",
                p_DEL_MODE  = "SCLK_ALIGNED",
                p_DEL_VALUE = "DELAY{}".format(rx_delay_taps),
                i_LOADN     = 1,
                i_MOVE      = 0,
                i_DIRECTION = 0,
                i_A         = pads.rx_ctl,
                o_Z         = rx_ctl_delayf),
]
```

This results in a design where all the IO_DELAY blocks are set to the same value. 
(The value set is actually 50 rather than 0 because of the `SCLK_ALIGNED` mode see nextpnr code [here](https://github.com/YosysHQ/nextpnr/blob/576baa994f4b9e1746a231469bfd9e65d1d5a2b4/ecp5/pack.cc#L1981) )

This creates a design that sometimes runs, but sometimes does not run because the timing is very marginal.
